name: PT Olympus Strategic Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT Olympus Strategic Indonesia Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, develops, owns, trades in, invests in, and operates hotels, villas, resorts, and other properties in Indonesia. The company was formerly known as PT Nusantara PT Surya Permata Andalan Tbk and changed its name to PT Olympus Strategic Indonesia Tbk in May 2026. PT Olympus Strategic Indonesia Tbk was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Bali, Indonesia.
